title: Owner
description:
**Company Description**
VVDN Technologies is a global provider of software, product engineering, and electronics manufacturing services, offering end-to-end solutions from design to production. The company operates 11 R&D centers across India and Vietnam, 9 manufacturing facilities in Manesar, Pollachi, and Vizag, and 6 global offices in the US, Canada, Japan, Vietnam, Korea, and Europe. VVDN serves clients as a one-stop partner for hardware and software development, cloud and apps, mechanical design, testing, automation, pre-compliance, and manufacturing. With India headquarters at Global Innovation Park in Manesar, Gurugram, and North America headquarters in Fremont, CA, VVDN supports next-generation solutions in Adaptive Compute & Communications, Networking & Wi-Fi, IoT, Vision, Automotive, and Cloud & Apps.
  
**Role Description**
The Owner role is a full-time, on-site position based in Ernakulam, responsible for overseeing overall business operations, strategic direction, and growth initiatives for VVDN Technologies in the region. This role includes setting business objectives, monitoring performance, and ensuring alignment with the company’s global vision and standards. The Owner manages key stakeholder relationships, including major customers, partners, and internal leadership, and provides guidance on product, engineering, and manufacturing priorities. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing financial performance, supervising local leadership teams, making decisions on investments and resource allocation, and ensuring compliance with corporate policies and regional regulations. The role also involves identifying new market opportunities, driving operational excellence, and fostering a collaborative, inclusive workplace culture.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong leadership and people management skills, with experience guiding cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
* Proven experience in business strategy, operations management, and P&L ownership within technology, engineering, or manufacturing domains.
* Solid understanding of product engineering, software development, and electronics manufacturing processes, preferably in areas such as IoT, networking, or embedded systems.
* Financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis, with the ability to make data-driven decisions.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills for engaging customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Ability to work on-site in Ernakulam and collaborate effectively with global offices and R&D/manufacturing centers.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Management, or a related field; entrepreneurial or ownership experience is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with global technology markets, regulatory requirements, and best practices in quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.

title: Construction Manager - (Industrial Projects) - Vizag
description:
**Job Title**
 Construction Manager \- (Industrial Projects) \- Vizag
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 This role supports end\-to\-end delivery of large\-scale construction projects, assisting in project planning, scheduling, budgeting, procurement, and contract administration. The role includes monitoring site execution, ensuring quality standards, safety compliance, and risk mitigation. Works closely with multidisciplinary teams, consultants, clients, and contractors to support timely project completion within scope and budget, while contributing to cost efficiency, operational excellence, and overall client satisfaction across all civil project phases.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
* Oversee end\-to\-end management of civil construction projects from initiation to completion
* Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets in alignment with project objectives
* Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams including engineers, consultants, contractors, and site supervisors
* Monitor project progress, milestones, and deliverables to ensure timely execution
* Oversee procurement planning, vendor evaluation, and material management to maintain cost efficiency
* Administer contracts, review variations, and manage claims and billing in coordination with QS and commercial teams
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, environmental, and statutory regulations at all project stages
* Conduct regular site inspections and audits to monitor work quality and adherence to design specifications
* Identify project risks and implement effective mitigation and contingency strategies
* Coordinate with clients, architects, consultants, and internal stakeholders to maintain clear communication and alignment
* Ensure all civil works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, standards, and best practices
* Support project closure activities, including documentation, handover, and final settlement


**About You**
* B.E. / B. Tech in Civil Engineering
* 5 to 8 Years \& above of relevant experience
* Should have completed at least 4\- 6 institutional/University/residential/Commercial/industrial or similar projects along with infra works projects end to end during the tenure
* Candidate working with Project Management Consultancy would be preferred
* Technical awareness of civil, electro\-mechanical, and architectural works
* Excellent organizational and motivational skills
* Outstanding attention to detail and observation ability
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities


**Why join Cushman \& Wakefield?**
 As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman \& Wakefield means you will benefit from;
   

  

* Being part of a growing global company;

 We're committed to providing work\-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.
   

  

 We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.
